purpose: Public certificate fixture for offline client trust-store loading tests. No network or peer handshake is required.

certificate.material: One public X.509 root certificate. No private key is included.

public_source.verification: The certificate identity and DER SHA-256 fingerprint match the public ACCVRAIZ1 entry in this source.

acquisition.method: An existing public certificate was extracted from the local platform default trust store using Python ssl.create_default_context().get_ca_certs(binary_form=True) and serialized with ssl.DER_cert_to_PEM_cert.
acquisition.generation: The fixture acquisition did not generate a certificate or private key.
acquisition.ownership: Owned refers to the test copy and its selection. Framey did not author, generate, or acquire ownership of the ACCVRAIZ1 trust anchor.
